graph_specialization_lemma.regularity_reason: in(u-f) is monic in u on each central associated-graded packet, which is obtained from the central packet by polynomial extension in u

mathematical_scope: Exact characteristic-zero theorem for every compatible formal tensor with fixed nodal cubic symbol. The exact graded gauge cokernel is Q[y,z](-3), so recursive filtered gauge elimination gives h_nod+f(y,z)*eta with f in (y,z)Q[[y,z]]. The universal coefficient multiplication is affine-linear, its intrinsic different Nakayama module is Q[u]^6, and weight-one strict Rees packets make u-f regular under every graph specialization. Hence the intrinsic Kahler different has six minimal local generators and is non-Cartier to all formal orders. Normality, algebraization of an arbitrary formal gauge, and Keller-open compatibility are not asserted.
